'''Assimilated Adventurers''' are the [[Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Version]] of the Player.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawns when a player is killed by parasitic mobs while having the [[Call Of The Hive]] effect.
* Spawns in groups of 3 to 5, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]] to [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]], with a spawnweight of 25.
* Spawned by level 4 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].
* If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when a [[Thrall]] is killed.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Assimilated Adventurers are Melee Combatants.

* Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* They are capable of wearing whatever Armor the Player had equipped before being assimilated, except the chestplate.
* Any [[Mobs|Mob]] within 3 blocks of an Assimilated Adventurer will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive]]. This does not go through walls.
* Assimilated Adventurers are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* Assimilated Adventurers are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* If an Assimilated Adventurer gets 5 kills and is within range of a [[Moving Flesh]] or 3 other [[Assimilated Mobs]]<ref>Excluding [[Assimilated Ender Dragon]] and [[Assimilated Big Spider]].</ref>, it will evolve into a [[Moving Flesh]].
* If an Assimilated Adventurer gets 15 kills and is unable to turn into [[Moving Flesh]], it will evolve into a [[Thrall]].
* On death, Assimilated Adventurers have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Assimilated Remains]], 3-4 [[Buglin|Buglins]], and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** When not exploding, there is a 50% chance an Assimilated Adventurer will drop its [[Walking Adventurer Head|Head]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Assimilated Adventurers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

== ''Trivia'' ==
* Assimilated Adventurers are known internally as '''Infplayer''', which is short for "Infected Player".
* Assimilated Adventurers spawned from a defeated player will bear that player's name tag, while those spawned naturally will have a name tag picked randomly from an internal list. The possible names are those of developers, moderators on the official Discord server, and the mod's financial supporters.
